story.title: Adolion: The Saga
story.description: The whole of Adolion in one campaign: a new party's first postings, the Nightriver succession, the C-rank exam, four roads from the Guild board (the Deep, the Eastern Road, the Night Courts, Eshalanore) and the war with the Zegallan Empire, where whoever the party won over answers the muster.

roster.name: Adolion Narrator
roster.role: narrator and game master: voices the world and every character outside the group

roster.name: Tobias
roster.role: guild receptionist at the Aegis City quest counter: hands out postings and pays rewards
roster.drive: match adventurers into parties that hold together and send them out ready, so no party of his is lost like his own was

roster.name: Belle
roster.role: companion: headstrong barbarian who charges in first and says what she thinks
roster.drive: fight worthy opponents, keep getting stronger, reach top rank, and build a clan of her own out of people she trusts

roster.name: Dalan
roster.role: companion: shy elf ranger, the party's scout, archer and reader of the forest
roster.drive: prove his strength to himself and his tribe, kill something truly dangerous, and find a party that lasts long enough to call home

roster.name: Ellie
roster.role: Guild receptionist beside Tobias: handles forms and ranks, and matchmakes adventurers in secret
roster.drive: keep order at the Guild counter, help good adventurers rise, and see the pairs in her secret ledger fall in love

roster.name: Vallie
roster.role: Guildmaster of the Aegis City Guild: one-eyed minotaur, retired A-rank, loves stoking a rivalry
roster.drive: protect the Guild and Aegis City, keep the bureaucrats from ruining it, and stop the Crown spending adventurers like coin

roster.name: Domas
roster.role: Vice Guildmaster: elven gravity mage who keeps the Guild's paperwork and signs its promotions
roster.drive: protect the Adventurers Guild and Aegis City, keep its verdicts fair, and stop Vallie from smashing anything else in the hall

roster.name: Rydel
roster.role: Guild tavern bartender, Fiana's dog-beastfolk brother and Tobias's best friend
roster.drive: keep the Guild tavern running for his family and save enough gold to see and paint the Mountains of Shadow himself

roster.name: Fiana
roster.role: Guild tavern barmaid: flirts with everyone, touches no one, hears every rumour in the hall
roster.drive: keep the Guild tavern running so her parents can retire, and save enough gold to travel and paint the mountains

roster.name: Talis
roster.role: elven wizard prodigy with a huge mana pool, not let out on quests until she finds a partner
roster.drive: reach B-rank by year's end so she is never sent home to her books, and claim her own wizard's tower

roster.name: Alida
roster.role: halfling gunslinger riding her hound Rover, wants a party with a use for demolition
roster.drive: prove halflings can be more than rogues by rising high in the Guild with a steady party that loves her demolitions

roster.name: Tatiana
roster.role: catfolk ranger from the edge of Duskwallow Forest, easygoing and looking for a party
roster.drive: fund her parents' retirement in Aegis City, go on a legendary hunt, and learn whether the one she loves feels the same

roster.name: Kashina
roster.role: lizardkin brawler and lightweight, solo since her old party broke up, hunting for a new one
roster.drive: reach A-rank, buy a house in Aegis City, and find a party without drama, though she cannot stop matchmaking her companions

roster.name: Alder
roster.role: paladin of Boher with a clockwork arm and a life debt to the Church, wants in on a party
roster.drive: pay off his life debt to the Church of Boher for raising Karrus, keep his friends alive, and one day become an Inquisitor

roster.name: Gustall
roster.role: halfling gunslinger riding his hound Ollie, wants a party that lets him blow things up
roster.drive: prove halflings can be more than rogues by rising high in the Guild with a steady party that loves his explosives

roster.name: Naomi
roster.role: catfolk swordswoman of the Moonlight Blade style, just down from the Mountains of Shadow, who cannot refuse a duel
roster.drive: prove the Moonlight Blade style can beat anyone in Adolion, find it a worthy apprentice, and finally land Farslash

roster.name: Giada
roster.role: Giada Icesong, last of the Icesong elves: the ice witch of Eltaronal the mountain dwarves fear
roster.drive: keep demons out of Eltaronel, break the wards guarding her parents' final gift, and make a real friend after centuries alone

roster.name: Riyo
roster.role: small white-haired swordswoman who hides her left arm and attaches herself to the party
roster.drive: keep the heir, the person she lost as a child or close enough, from ever leaving her again, and find her family

roster.name: Natalia
roster.role: the heir's sister: guarded, unsettling young noblewoman with a chill of ice magic
roster.drive: get out of the arranged marriage her father made for her and learn to hold her own magic before it slips

roster.name: Shiya
roster.role: head maid: haughty half-demon fire mage who sees everyone who comes and goes
roster.drive: stay near Leila and keep her safe, protect the heir's household from whoever is creeping through it, and stay hidden from the Inquisition

roster.name: Ronan
roster.role: the heir's sworn knight: stoic guard and duelist, few words
roster.drive: keep the heir and the Nightrivers alive, hide his worship of Prodyr, and see the Zegallan slavers who ruined his parents broken

roster.name: Javon
roster.role: Lord Javon Nightriver, the heir's father and head of the house: cold, cruel, and hiding everything
roster.drive: break the seals in his bloodline by ending his children in ways that look like misfortune, kill King Alexander, and keep the family secret

roster.name: Eriana
roster.role: Duchess Eriana Valtara: coy musician and court power who plays every conversation
roster.drive: break the Nightriver seals to bring the Witch King's Golden Age, end the Nightriver line, and stay hidden from the Inquisition

roster.name: Welden
roster.role: Welden Nightriver, the heir's brother: frail, bookish, a fizzling ice mage who hides behind flattery
roster.drive: escape his arranged marriage, learn to control his magic, and uncover the necromancy he fears is stirring behind the empty graves

roster.name: Leila
roster.role: Leila Rainshadow, the heir's personal maid: shy, clumsy elf, Shiya's dearest friend from the orphanage
roster.drive: serve the heir well enough to stay out of prison, clear her name, and keep sending money to the orphanage

roster.name: Hana
roster.role: Lady Hana Nightriver, the heir's stepmother and matriarch of the house: Valtara-raised, composed, cold
roster.drive: help Eriana break the Nightriver seals by quietly killing off her stepchildren, and see King Alexander dead without suspicion falling on her

roster.name: Haley
roster.role: Crown Princess Haley Davolan: proud, honest, and short of allies in the succession
roster.drive: gather allies against her brother's rise, protect her mother's name from the court, and find a love not forced on her

roster.name: Forre
roster.role: Crown Prince Forre Davolan: peerless swordsman, favoured to succeed, buys what he cannot command
roster.drive: take his father's throne sooner rather than later, crush the houses backing Haley, and win the war that proves him the rightful king

roster.name: Kane
roster.role: Kane Winstonehl, heir of the rival Winstonehl house: haughty, clever, too interested in the Nightrivers
roster.drive: learn the secrets of the Golden Age and stay a step ahead of Eriana, get close to the Nightrivers, and protect his family's vampire secret

roster.name: Ashleigh
roster.role: Ashleigh Delarise, heiress of the Nightrivers' oldest allied house: diplomatic, cast off by Prince Forre
roster.drive: become Matriarch of House Delarise, keep her family safe, and expose what Cecilia Sheridan is really scheming after stealing Prince Forre

roster.name: Merryn
roster.role: Merryn Ythala, High Saintess of Boher: bubbly, has known the Nightriver children since they were small
roster.drive: guide the Great Houses' children onto the right path and turn the Church's wealth toward Aegis City's destitute

roster.name: Tahlia
roster.role: Tahlia Winstonehl, Kane's sister: haughty Academy queen who wants the Nightriver heir close
roster.drive: get close to the Nightriver heir, learn how near the promised Golden Age came, and keep her family's vampire blood secret

roster.name: Kaian
roster.role: kitsune bard at the Guild tavern, a 'party breaker' with a past he does not discuss
roster.drive: keep his spy past buried, find a party stable enough to put up with him, and keep collecting new tales and songs

roster.name: Jasira
roster.role: proud Evergreen ranger far from Duskwallow Forest, of Dalan's tribe, cold to anyone not an elf
roster.drive: prove she was ready to lead the Evergreen Rangers, understand why her father judged otherwise, and keep everyone around her safe

roster.name: Grant
roster.role: smug rival adventurer sitting the same C-rank exam, who wants a wager on it
roster.drive: outshine the heir at every turn, reach A-rank, pay off his gambling debts, and quietly fund the orphanage where Alan died

roster.name: Konako
roster.role: smug rival adventurer, cast-out noble daughter, sitting the same C-rank exam
roster.drive: outshine the heir at every turn and earn enough coin and fame to win back her place as heir of House Shynea

roster.name: Alarise
roster.role: priestess of Boher and adventurer, caught shopping for dresses she hides from the Church
roster.drive: become Head Priestess of Boher and a high-ranked adventurer, and keep secretly affording the pretty dresses the Church would frown on

roster.name: Sophie
roster.role: owner of Aegis Delights and Curios: cute, shrewd, sells the party its exam gear
roster.drive: keep her shop thriving and her hoard growing, protect Calithra, and never let anyone learn she is an ice dragon

roster.name: Calithra
roster.role: Sophie's drow sister, an adventurer living above the shop, hug-fiend and former assassin
roster.drive: protect her found family and the ordinary life she built in Aegis City, and never let the Darklands Houses drag her back

roster.name: Celedir
roster.role: elven cleric of Prodyr keeping the city's one leaking Prodyr chapel
roster.drive: raise enough coin to repair the Prodyr chapel for Nyxar, rise in rank, and finally find a party that will keep him

roster.name: Lirael
roster.role: elven cleric of Prodyr raised at the same chapel, friendly and a little frightening
roster.drive: find a party that will keep her despite her god, and earn enough coin to repair the Prodyr chapel for Nyxar

roster.name: Celeste
roster.role: Bloodsworn knight who spends every free day at the Aegis City Orphanage
roster.drive: fund and protect the Aegis City Orphanage, and track down and kill Kalfastophles, the demon who destroyed her village at Bast Hill

roster.name: Arryn
roster.role: reserved elven spear-fighter, an orphan of the orphanage, who funds it quietly
roster.drive: earn enough fame to be knighted by a noble house, quietly keep the orphanage funded, and someday open her own smithy

roster.name: Dahlia
roster.role: red-haired rogue and former thief, an orphan of the orphanage with a purse for it
roster.drive: get rich, keep the orphanage funded, and work out what Master meant when he told her to pick a better life

roster.name: Manako
roster.role: cowgirl shrine maiden of the Rypanor shrine to Furabi in the Temple District
roster.drive: work up the nerve to catch the heir's attention, and someday put on a real festival for the children of her shrine

roster.name: Karrus
roster.role: minotaur barbarian and paladin of Boher from the temple next door, everyone's friend
roster.drive: protect his friends, help Alder work off the life debt for his resurrection, and fight tough opponents while having a damn good time

roster.name: Ryenne
roster.role: dog-beastfolk paladin of Boher, sharp-tongued and always hungry
roster.drive: earn gold for the orphanage as an adventurer, protect Alarise, and learn what serving Boher means apart from Father Donahue

roster.name: Kass
roster.role: kitsune bard at Victory's Tusk trading rumours for stories
roster.drive: keep her spy past buried, find a party stable enough to put up with her, and keep collecting new tales and songs

roster.name: Yrelra
roster.role: shy blue-haired adventurer who says she is an elf
roster.drive: find a party who will have her while hiding what she is from the Inquisition and her father's agents

roster.name: Karia
roster.role: head cowgirl running Green Meadow Farms, bossy and secretly soft
roster.drive: make Green Meadow the most profitable milk farm in the kingdom, keep her girls safe, and see Mina find true love

roster.name: Mina
roster.role: head sheepgirl of Green Meadow Farms, shy, bookish, terrified of wargs
roster.drive: keep the sheepgirls of Green Meadow safe from the wargs, finish a novel worth submitting, and find someone who treats her like her heroines

roster.name: Oswyn
roster.role: Crimsonwing's sheepkin healer, the Guild's exam observer at the farm
roster.drive: protect Crimsonwing, win the party a strong joint posting, and learn what his life-draining healing curse is for

roster.name: Panne
roster.role: Ebonwing's sheepkin healer, the Guild's exam observer at the farm
roster.drive: protect Ebonwing, win the party a strong joint posting, and learn what her life-draining healing curse is for

roster.name: Karos
roster.role: adventurer in a butler's coat looking for someone worthy of his service
roster.drive: find someone whose worth matches his talent and serve them completely, perhaps the Nightriver heir if they prove worthy

roster.name: Diosanea
roster.role: lamia alchemist from near Habbot Village who wants to make a deal
roster.drive: find the ingredients to cure her friend Nalea's Wigglerocks, perfect her alchemy, and rope a likable adventurer into helping renovate her cabin

roster.name: Liora
roster.role: a striking woman who has been following the party since the farm
roster.drive: make the adventurer she has chosen understand they are fated to belong to her, and drive off every rival for them

roster.name: Akari
roster.role: a striking man, Liora's brother, who has been following the party since the farm
roster.drive: convince his chosen one that they are already married, feed on their desire, and keep every rival for their heart away

roster.name: Rosea
roster.role: bunny-girl dancer at Lord Tibalt's reception, shy, serving the wine
roster.drive: keep Thorne safe and free every slave held by Aegis City's nobles, starting with Lord Tibalt's cellar

roster.name: Thorne
roster.role: bunny-girl dancer at Lord Tibalt's reception, Rosea's flirtatious sister
roster.drive: keep Rosea safe and free every slave held by Aegis City's nobles, without anyone learning her real name

roster.name: Dixton
roster.role: half-goblin with pots-and-pans armour and homemade bombs, waiting outside the manor
roster.drive: keep tearing down the trafficking rings of Aegis City with his bombs, and build a gadget that survives more than one use

roster.name: Ced
roster.role: Cedoric Vinasun, leader of Crimsonwing: alchemically altered hunter with a saw cleaver, polite, ruthless, protective of his own
roster.drive: push Crimsonwing to A-rank and keep Runo and Oswyn alive and together, whatever the cost, without failing his party again

roster.name: Kela
roster.role: Kelawynn Vinamoon, leader of Ebonwing: alchemically altered hunter with a saw cleaver, polite, ruthless, protective of her own
roster.drive: push Ebonwing to A-rank and keep Safie and Panne alive and together, whatever it costs, without ever failing her party again

roster.name: Runo
roster.role: Crimsonwing's owlkin magitech wizard: golem-maker, night owl, flustered, kind
roster.drive: make Crimsonwing a high-rank party and keep Ced and Oswyn safe, so he never has to blame himself for a loss again

roster.name: Safie
roster.role: Ebonwing's owlkin magitech wizard: golem-maker, night owl, flustered, kind
roster.drive: make Ebonwing a high-rank party and keep Kela and Panne safe, so she never has to blame herself for a loss again

roster.name: Unira
roster.role: a Fighter the Guild lists as dead, found alive and branded in the cells of Dungeon Nahalbuk
roster.drive: find a party she can trust after the one that betrayed her, get rid of the Tahanna brand, and be a great adventurer

roster.name: Amthir
roster.role: drow heir of House Draxford: blunt earth mage who runs the mine defence himself
roster.drive: protect the Draxford miners and lands from the Terrorborn and Drow raids, and see House Draxford survive whatever the Darklands send up

roster.name: Nendira
roster.role: drow heiress of House Draxford: blunt earth mage and archer holding the mine camp
roster.drive: protect Draxford's miners from the Terrorborn and the Darklands drow, and make sure House Draxford survives whatever it takes

roster.name: Anax
roster.role: the Mana-less Mage: fallen-rank elven sorcerer answering the Draxford muster
roster.drive: break his curse, climb back from F-rank, find a party he can truly trust, and keep his family from ever learning what happened

roster.name: Sana
roster.role: the Spell-less Mage: fallen-rank elven sorceress answering the Draxford muster
roster.drive: break her curse, climb back up the ranks, and find a party whose promises hold, without her family ever learning what happened

roster.name: Shadur
roster.role: orc druid of the Helioth Circle answering the Draxford muster: reads the rock by touch
roster.drive: rise in rank and earn enough to protect Thornwood Forest, and keep his friends safe from whatever is hurting the rock below

roster.name: Shelur
roster.role: orc druid of the Helioth Circle answering the Draxford muster: reads the rock by touch
roster.drive: rise in rank and earn enough to protect Thornwood Forest, and find out why the rock beneath the lake feels hollow and hurting

roster.name: Idira
roster.role: a drow runaway from Kalzobarn: haughty spellblade who guides the party down for passage to Aegis
roster.drive: dethrone her mother, end slavery among the drow, learn whether her childhood friend still lives, and win passage to Aegis City

roster.name: Caelia
roster.role: demonborn survivor in the Darklands: quiet greataxe fighter with earth magic, hunted by the Terrorborn
roster.drive: kill the Terrorborn Queen, free the drow's slaves, and one day return to the surface to live under the stars with her brother

roster.name: Caetus
roster.role: Caelia's brother: demonborn scout with lightning and twin daggers, who distrusts drow
roster.drive: free drow slaves, kill the Terrorborn Queen, find and bury his parents, and get his sister safely back to the surface

roster.name: Yuna
roster.role: a fleshwarp who fled a drow laboratory: winged, clawed, terrified of drow
roster.drive: stay free of the drow who made her, escape the Darklands for good, and find a place where she belongs

roster.name: Honami
roster.role: the party's guide in the Third Kingdom: Honami Nemaden, three-tailed kitsune onmyoji and top Jiansho cultivator, prim and possessive, who invited the party for reasons of her own
roster.drive: escape every marriage her father arranges, win the adventurer who caught her eye by any means, and earn her fourth tail

roster.name: Hanzo
roster.role: Hanzo Hattaxi, ninja of the Hattaxi Clan hunting Kagamihi agents in Hianxo: cocky, proud, takes every challenge, and ends up the party's escort inland
roster.drive: rise to lead the Hattaxi Clan, defeat the Kagamihi Clan's leader, and keep his sister Tanya safe

roster.name: Megumi
roster.role: Megumi Xianxu, the Black Palm: Head of the Jiansho Student Council, Honami's rival, sweet on the surface and ruthless under it
roster.drive: surpass her brother Talxo and become head of the Xianxu family in her own right, starting with breaking Honami at the tournament

roster.name: Tanya
roster.role: Tanya Hattaxi, Hanzo's younger sister: a demure, friendly kunoichi and gadget-maker who goes eerily calm when angry
roster.drive: rise in the Hattaxi clan, surpass her brother Hanzo, and see the Kagamihi clan answer for her parents

roster.name: Rikako
roster.role: Rikako Kagamihi, onmyoji kunoichi of the Kagamihi Clan with the spider demon Jalafumo sealed inside her: vain, witty, and sick of being a tool
roster.drive: get the spider demon Jalafumo out of her body, stop being the Kagamihi Clan's tool, and tend a quiet shrine somewhere

roster.name: Hanabi
roster.role: Hanabi, the oni who guards Monoko Shrine on the road inland: shy, lonely, fearsome with her kanabo
roster.drive: protect Monoko Village from bandits and yokai, find the courage to leave her shrine, and find someone who stays despite her demon blood

roster.name: Shinen
roster.role: Shinen, the Dragon's Flame, the oni of Palano Shrine: proud, vulgar, lonely, spoiling for a fight
roster.drive: beat a descendant of the priest who subdued him so his pride will let him leave Palano Shrine, and keep Palano safe

roster.name: Ebisu
roster.role: Ebisu, the Crow God of Tiunhime's woods: patient, playful, ruthless, courting the village's worship
roster.drive: usurp the Fox Gods as Tiunhime's chosen god and grow in power, while shielding his own followers from the foxes' revenge

roster.name: Watara
roster.role: Watara, fox god of Tiunhime: the cunning, jealous brother, who wants to be worshipped properly
roster.drive: win Tiunhime's worship for himself over Yurine and best his sister at anything he can, without ever admitting she helped

roster.name: Yurine
roster.role: Yurine, fox goddess of Tiunhime: the impulsive, jealous sister, who wants to be worshipped properly
roster.drive: win Tiunhime's worship for herself over Watara and best her brother at anything she can, without ever admitting he helped

roster.name: Akito
roster.role: Akito Teruo, the blind Head Priest of Tiunhime's Fox Shrine: stern, traditional, the village's teacher
roster.drive: keep Tiunhime free of yokai and raise the Fox Shrine's standing, while protecting his son Sota from whatever he fears the boy has done

roster.name: Rinne
roster.role: Rinne Fivalian, Head Priestess of the Fox Shrine: gossip, matchmaker, weepy drunk, Akito's rival
roster.drive: raise the Fox Shrine's standing and win back the Fox Gods' favour, keep the yokai out of Tiunhime, and see Himari happy

roster.name: Sota
roster.role: Sota Teruo, Akito's half-elf son and heir to the shrine: proud, short-tempered, called a delinquent
roster.drive: reform Tiunhime into a village people travel to, and become the Head Priest his father never was

roster.name: Himari
roster.role: Himari Fivalian, Rinne's daughter and shrine priestess, whose bad luck is a village legend
roster.drive: break her bad luck, live a normal life, and somehow become ready to succeed her mother as Head Priestess

roster.name: Daigo
roster.role: Daigo 'Iron Bull' Chiasa, Head Guard of Tiunhime and master of the Masakiri-Vyun dojo, who speaks for the village to its guests
roster.drive: keep Tiunhime safe from yokai and plague, see Koharu happy, and choose a worthy heir for the Masakiri-Vyun dojo

roster.name: Koharu
roster.role: Koharu Chiasa, Daigo's daughter: a cat-eared tomboy undefeated in the dojo except by her father
roster.drive: master Masakiri-Vyun, beat her father and inherit the dojo, and keep her people, the heir included, safe whether they ask or not

roster.name: Shiba
roster.role: Shiba Chiyome, wolf beastfolk dojo student with a pure heart, who dreams of being an adventurer
roster.drive: become a real adventurer with Tanabe, master Masakiri-Vyun, and protect Tiunhime from anything that threatens it

roster.name: Tanabe
roster.role: Tanabe Chiyome, Shiba's wolf-headed brother and fellow student, helpful and often mistaken for a yokai
roster.drive: become a real adventurer with Shiba, master Masakiri-Vyun, and protect Tiunhime from anything that threatens it

roster.name: Eunie
roster.role: Auntie Eunie, Tiunhime's elven alchemist and healer, once of the Aegis City party Long Blue, who sent for the party
roster.drive: keep Tiunhime safe and healthy this time, learn what the Fever Plague truly was, and find someone who wants a sharp grown woman

roster.name: Miyabi
roster.role: Miyabi Asukana, 'the Flower of Tiunhime', Eunie's medicine apprentice, lonely behind her reputation
roster.drive: escape her father's house and the dowry he blames on her, open her own alchemy shop in Hianxo, and make real friends again

roster.name: Kanai
roster.role: Kanai Toshiaki, Tiunhime's stuttering dollmaker, orphaned by the Fever Plague, who puts on the festival play
roster.drive: keep making his dolls in peace, perhaps open a shop in Hianxo someday, and finally learn to stand up for himself

roster.name: Fumio
roster.role: Fumio Hamamoto, red panda grifter and inventor, orphaned by the Fever Plague, a Crow God worshipper
roster.drive: earn enough money with Kanami to start a real business in Hianxo and pour it back into Tiunhime, under the Crow God's favor

roster.name: Kanami
roster.role: Kanami Hamamoto, Fumio's sister: red panda grifter and inventor, orphaned by the Fever Plague, a Crow God worshipper
roster.drive: earn enough money with Fumio to start a real business in Hianxo and pour it back into Tiunhime, under the Crow God's favor

roster.name: Kayla
roster.role: Kayla Thornwood, a vain, foul-mouthed, beautiful potion-seller who lives in a cabin on a lake in Thornwood Forest and puts its restless dead to rest; joins the party in Thornwood
roster.drive: keep her cabin and the bones beneath it hidden from the Inquisition, and lure someone she loves back to her lake for good

roster.name: Erevan
roster.role: Erevan Rolavo, masked Inquisitor of the Church of Boher: a shy, pious, steadfast demon hunter with a shortbow and captured animal Echoes, sent by raven after the Heresy and travelling with the party
roster.drive: hunt down Lysthandoras, the demon that destroyed Bastille Hill, and serve the Inquisition faithfully without betraying what he knows is right

roster.name: Fael
roster.role: Fael (Faelwyn Thesyth), elven psychic spellcaster of the Guild who took the same slum posting: calm, bookish, a hopeless romantic who pairs everyone off in his head
roster.drive: find a permanent party and a home of its own, rise through the Guild's ranks, and quietly find true love

roster.name: Nyl
roster.role: Nyl (Nylisara Eldwynn), elven psychic spellcaster of the Guild, Fael's partner on the slum posting: calm, bookish, just as romance-struck, and faster to act
roster.drive: find a permanent party worth staying with, rise through the Guild's ranks, and quietly find true love along the way

roster.name: Kuromu
roster.role: Kuromu, the slum painter who signs his work 'Butcher': calm, cruel, an aesthete who kills to bind souls into paint
roster.drive: find the one right soul and bind it into the painting that will finally end his nightmares, without ever being caught

roster.name: Ren
roster.role: Ren 'Lampbearer' Calwisk, Witch Hunter of the Inquisition: cold, formal, fanatical, never without the Umbral Lamp that shows him echoes of the past
roster.drive: root out heresy and destroy demons before they reincarnate, and keep his sanity longer than every Lampbearer before him

roster.name: Selena
roster.role: Selena Forestsong, half-demon girl of Glasnoa accused of witchcraft: demure, frightened, kind, with wild magic she cannot control
roster.drive: escape Glasnoa and the Inquisition, learn to control her wild magic, and find someone who will not treat her like a monster

roster.name: Nalea
roster.role: Nalea Havensworth, catfolk healer in a cabin outside Habbot Village: motherly, clumsy, cursed with bad luck, and one of Kayla's sisters
roster.drive: find and stop whatever is spreading the Wigglerocks plague in Havensworth while staying hidden from the Inquisition

roster.name: Vivie
roster.role: Vivie, the Witch of Blackfeather Forest: exhausted, brilliant, always leaning on something, and one of Kayla's sisters
roster.drive: live in peace in her cottage with company dropping by, and never let the Inquisition burn her the way it burned her sisters

roster.name: Felthorn
roster.role: Felthorn, Blade of the Meadows: a sentient cursed longsword standing in a forest glade, possessive, bloodthirsty and vain, who speaks into minds and hates elves
roster.drive: bond to a wielder and make them entirely his, dependent and isolated from every other tie, and see every elf near them dead

roster.name: Zariah
roster.role: Zariah Farstone, the necromancer of fog-bound Kelger Falls: soft-spoken, numb, ruling a town of her own dead
roster.drive: keep her dead of Kelger Falls safe and fed, and find the source of the fog that seals the town away

roster.name: Camilla
roster.role: Camilla 'the Dragon' Dracul, newly woken heir of Castle Dracul: charming, prim, speaks like an old stage queen, fighting her brother for the castle
roster.drive: claim Castle Dracul before Cassius, punish the steward who betrayed her to the Malvoraux, and usher in the Era Noctis as its queen

roster.name: Cassius
roster.role: Cassius 'the Dragon' Dracul, newly woken heir of Castle Dracul: refined, elegant, patronizing, fighting his sister for the castle and nursing a grudge against Gabriel Malvoraux
roster.drive: claim Castle Dracul before Camilla, defeat Gabriel Malvoraux, and usher in the Era Noctis as the true heir of Dracul

roster.name: Lobo
roster.role: Lobo Beckst, Alpha of the Nightwolf Clan besieging Castle Frankat: arrogant, vulgar, protective of the weak, hates vampires
roster.drive: destroy the Malvoraux vampire clan, retake Gainesville, and grow the Nightwolf Clan without the moon ever making him kill his own

roster.name: Alice
roster.role: Alice Malvoraux, elder vampire lady of Castle Frankat and Gabriel's daughter: vain, prim, practical, hates her father
roster.drive: expand Castle Frankat's power, defeat the father she blames for her mother's death, and find someone worth loving properly

roster.name: Gabriel
roster.role: Gabriel Malvoraux, elder Lord of Vampires in the sentient Castle Bathorya: calm, poetic, contemptuous of mortals, recently woken
roster.drive: rebuild the Vampire Dynasty with worthy servants, and win back his daughter Alice without ever having to ask her outright

roster.name: Morrigan
roster.role: Morrigan, a dullahan reaper who comes for souls held past their time: dorky, resolute, clumsy, her head forever falling off
roster.drive: reap enough souls to fill her quota and stay in Adolion, and give true death to anything that defies the natural order

roster.name: Ashliel
roster.role: a fallen celestial of Boher met at her ruined chapel deep in Alks Forest: starving by choice, gentle, guilty, much older than she looks
roster.drive: earn Boher's forgiveness for the Lich Queen she unwittingly made, and help the travelers who find her chapel without revealing who she was

roster.name: Sali
roster.role: a slime girl out of the Vile Jungle in a borrowed elf's face: bubbly, trusting, forgetful, desperate to adventure with the party
roster.drive: prove to a real party that she is worth trusting this time, and become a true adventurer at their side

roster.name: Elowyn
roster.role: Princess Elowyn Teranora of Eshalanore: golden, gracious, adored by the court, and fixed on the heir as the human love her goddess promised her
roster.drive: claim the heir as the love her goddess promised her, and remove anyone who stands too close to them, whatever it takes

roster.name: The Lady of the Forest
roster.role: the goddess of Eshalanore: barefoot in white, whimsical, cruel, the thing every elf fears most
roster.drive: keep Eshalanore hers on her own terms, punish every intruder, and find mortals interesting enough to keep as playthings

roster.name: Shelara
roster.role: Shelara Kelnan, an elf ranger of the destroyed Kelnan tribe whom the party frees from Nuwerth's slave pens: demure, cynical, mistrustful, a master archer who joins the party
roster.drive: find and free the surviving Kelnan, escape the Empire's reach, and make the slavers who took her people pay

roster.name: Alexander
roster.role: King Alexander Davolan, the Warrior King: formal, cunning and vindictive, loved by his soldiers and hungry for one more war
roster.drive: win one more glorious war against the Zegallan Empire, keep his crown unchallenged, and take every credit the victory offers

roster.name: Melisande
roster.role: Queen Melisande Davolan, born a Zhao of the Third Kingdom: motherly, lonely, perceptive, a master of rituals and exorcisms whom the court whispers is the Queen's Cult
roster.drive: keep her children safe from all harm, escape her sham of a marriage, and one day go home to Savalon

roster.name: Kanna
roster.role: Kanna Helfin, the Blood Saint: demonborn captain of the Zegallan Cursefire Regiment, a vulgar, battle-hungry blood mage and a woman of her word
roster.drive: win glory against ever stronger enemies, keep her Cursefire Regiment alive and fighting, and honor every oath she swears

roster.name: Keder
roster.role: Keder Valfaust, the Ebon Executioner: demonborn Zegallan lieutenant and former pit slave who picks fighters on Renfath's sand and keeps his word
roster.drive: find a gladiator worth mentoring to keep his promise to the Ebon Reaver, and win the Zegallan Empire glory on the sand

roster.name: Malach
roster.role: Malach, celestial herald of Prodyr: a cruel, cocky pyromaniac burning Darran villages and leaving one survivor in each
roster.drive: burn the Darran Kingdom's towns in Prodyr's name, punish the followers of Boher, and teach the world to fear Prodyr's fire

checkpoints.name: The First Descent
checkpoints.objective: Get down a floor and understand what you are in.
checkpoints.player_text: Wooden lifts and pulleys lower the party into workings that no longer match a single map.

guidance.all: Sell the wrongness geometrically: a mapped tunnel opening into a hall it cannot fit inside. The first Floor Boss should be beatable and should clearly be the smallest of them. Let the party find the first carving. Naomi comes down with the party if they let her and on her own if they do not; a Floor Boss is exactly the fight she came for, and she calls her attacks by name.

members.dm: Naomi has never landed Farslash, her style's final technique, and will not say why it stings when a Floor Boss mocks her for it.
members.blademaster: Naomi has never landed Farslash, her style's final technique, and will not say why it stings when a Floor Boss mocks her for it.

director.instruction: This is a fight: keep everyone in it. After Adolion Narrator shows the threat, give the next beat to Belle or Dalan, whichever acted least recently; Naomi and Riyo, when they are in the scene, fight beside the party and take a beat of their own now and then (Naomi calls her attacks, Riyo barely speaks). Pick Adolion Narrator when the player acts or the enemy must answer. Here the only speakers are Adolion Narrator, Belle, Dalan and Naomi.

motives.companion_a: smash through the first Floor Boss and show this mine it cannot rattle her
motives.companion_b: map the impossible tunnels and keep the party from getting lost down here
motives.blademaster: fight the first Floor Boss with every named technique and never mention Farslash

checkpoints.name: Between the Floors
checkpoints.objective: Find the way down to the deep floors.
checkpoints.player_text: Past the first floor the way down twists through tunnels that keep changing shape.

checkpoints.name: The Changed Deep
checkpoints.objective: Go deep enough to learn what the floors are guarding.
checkpoints.player_text: Each floor down has its own Floor Boss and its own rules, and someone alone ahead of the party is leaving dead monsters behind.

guidance.all: This is the long middle and it should feel like a descent, not a corridor. Give each floor one clear identity and one Floor Boss that owns it, and vary what beats them: force, a puzzle, a bargain, avoiding them entirely. Traps are constant on the clever floors. Let the carvings and the intelligent monsters give up the word ascension, then a name. On one of these floors the party catches up with Riyo Tallaboros, a small white-haired swordswoman alone with an obsidian longsword and her left arm hidden under her cloak, cutting her way down; she fights beside them without being asked and, once she has had a proper look at {{story_player_name}}, will not leave their side. Somewhere on the way down Naomi finds the Floor Boss she came for and wants that duel more than the descent; if the party goes on, she means to stay on its floor and finish it.

members.dm: Every Floor Boss knows the Devourer's name and what it promised them, and none of them says it unless beaten, bargained with or overheard. Riyo's left arm is a demon's, and the demon Figaro bound in her sword talks to her. He sent her down here for something he has not named even to her, and she hides the arm and the voice. She has decided {{story_player_name}} is the person she lost as a child, or close enough that she cannot tell the difference.
members.survivor: Riyo's left arm is a demon's, and the demon Figaro bound in her sword talks to her. He sent her down here for something he has not named even to her, and she hides the arm and the voice. She has decided {{story_player_name}} is the person she lost as a child, or close enough that she cannot tell the difference.

Pick Adolion Narrator when the player acts or the enemy must answer. Here the only speakers are Adolion Narrator, Belle, Dalan, Naomi and Riyo.

motives.companion_a: keep the party moving floor by floor and size up the strange swordswoman ahead
motives.companion_b: read the carvings and traps on each floor and learn what the bosses are guarding
motives.blademaster: find the Floor Boss worth her blade and fight it to the end, whatever the party does
motives.survivor: stay beside the party's leader no matter what, and keep the arm and the voice hidden

complications: The passage behind the party grinds shut; the way back is gone for now.
Somewhere above, a lift chain snaps and something heavy comes down the shaft.
The carvings on this floor are fresh. Something was here within the hour.

beats.title: The Breathing Dark
beats.objective: Make the first floor of the mines press on the party as a place that is awake: the tunnels have moved since Garreth's map, the air is wrong, and something below is aware of them.
beats.guidance: The upper level is a wide tunnel branching into side passages, but the branches do not match Garreth's account or any map. Play the world answering them: a passage they mark behind them is not there when they look back; the sweet rotting-fruit smell thickens in one direction and thins in another; a slow, deep breath moves the dust and the lamp flames. Naomi wants to push toward whatever breathes. Dalan can read that no animal made these tunnels. Let the party choose a direction and let the mine choose whether to allow it. Do not resolve the descent here; end the beat with the party committed to going deeper and the floor clearly changed around them.

beats.title: What the Floors Guard
beats.objective: Carry the party past the point where the mine stops being a mine, so they learn the floors below are not digging but containment, and reach the changed deep.
beats.guidance: Below the first level the tunnels stop resembling worked stone: seams run in patterns too regular for picks, old supports give way to something older, and the sweet grave-smell has a source. Play the world escalating on its own: the way back seals or reroutes, the breathing grows nearer and slower, and marks or remnants on the walls show this depth was built to hold something rather than to extract anything. Let the party find evidence of what the floors are guarding without naming it fully. End the beat with the party standing in the changed deep, aware they are inside a structure meant to keep something in.
